{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Read the CSV file
df = pd.read_csv('/data/food and beverage consumption.csv')

# Filter for satisfaction rating of 5
df_rating_5 = df[df['Satisfaction (1-5)'] == 5]

# Count satisfaction ratings of 5 by Food Type
food_type_counts = df_rating_5['Food Type'].value_counts()

# Find the food type with the most satisfaction ratings of 5
top_food_type = food_type_counts.idxmax()
top_food_count = food_type_counts.max()

# Get beverage types that accompany this food type when rating is 5
top_food_df = df_rating_5[df_rating_5['Food Type'] == top_food_type]
accompanying_beverages = top_food_df['Beverage Type'].value_counts()

print(f"Food type with the most satisfaction ratings of 5: {top_food_type} ({top_food_count} ratings)")
print("\nBeverage types accompanying this food type when rating is 5:")
for beverage, count in accompanying_beverages.items():
    print(f"  - {beverage}: {count} times")
"}
